<tr><th class="th"><div>Jun. 30, 2026</div></th></tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_CollaborativeArrangementsAndNoncollaborativeArrangementTransactionsLineItems', window );"><strong>Collaborative Arrangement and Arrangement Other than Collaborative [Line Items]</strong></a></td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Organization</a></td>
<td class="text"><p style="text-indent:-4.749%;tab-size:26.66px;padding-left:4.533%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">1.      </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Organization</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Macquarie Energy Transition Infrastructure Fund, L.P. (the &#8220;Fund&#8221;) is a Delaware limited partnership formed on </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">October 30, 2024</span></span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">, and is a private fund exempt from registration under Section 3(c)(7) of the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended (the &#8220;1940 Act&#8221;). The Fund operates pursuant to the Second Amended and Restated Limited Partnership Agreement, dated October 31, 2025, </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">as amended, and/or restated from time to time (the &#8220;Partnership Agreement&#8221;). The Fund is structured as a perpetual vehicle, with monthly, fully funded subscriptions and aims to make periodic redemptions.</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Fund is conducting a continuous private offering of Units on a monthly basis to prospective Investors who are both (i) accredited investors (as defined in Regulation D under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &#8220;Securities Act&#8221;)) and (ii) qualified purchasers (as defined in the 1940 Act and rules thereunder).</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Fund&#8217;s investment objective is to generate capital appreciation and yield over the medium-to-long term by investing primarily in a global portfolio of businesses and operating assets in the energy transition infrastructure sector with a focus on commercially scalable and proven technologies (</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#8220;</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Energy Transition Infrastructure Investments&#8221;), with a focus on mature technologies. The Fund may invest, directly or indirectly, in private infrastructure equity investments, composed of equity and equity-like investments in operational or developmental assets and platforms, including as a co-investor with any other vehicle that holds capital managed or advised by any MAM-Managed Entities, or indirectly through investments in MAM-Managed Entities.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Fund invests the majority of its assets in METI Cayman, L.P. (the &#8220;Aggregator&#8221;) in which the Fund held an interest of </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">20.94</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">%</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> and </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">15.64</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">%</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> as of June 30, 2026 and March 31, 2026, respectively. The Aggregator has the same investment objectives as the Fund. The Fund also invests a portion of its assets in Macquarie Green Energy and Climate Opportunities Fund SCSp (&#8220;MGECO&#8221;), a MAM-managed open-ended alternative investment fund. The Fund had an interest of </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">0.48</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">%</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> in MGECO as of June 30, 2026 and March 31, 2026.</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">METI GP, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, is the Fund&#8217;s general partner (the &#8220;General Partner&#8221;). Overall responsibility for the Fund&#8217;s oversight rests with the General Partner, subject to certain oversight rights held by the Fund&#8217;s Board of Directors (the &#8220;Board of Directors&#8221;). The General Partner delegates the portfolio management function of the Fund to Macquarie Wealth Advisers, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company and the Fund&#8217;s investment adviser (the &#8220;Adviser&#8221;). The Adviser shall constitute a &#8220;Manager&#8221; of the Fund within the meaning of the Delaware Limited Partnership Act. Both the General Partner and the Adviser are affiliates of Macquarie.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">METI TE Feeder, L.P. (the &#8220;Feeder&#8221;), a Delaware limited partnership, is a feeder vehicle of the Fund. The Feeder allows certain investors with particular tax characteristics, such as tax-exempt investors and non-U.S. investors, to participate in the Fund in a more efficient manner. The Feeder&#8217;s investment in the Fund represented </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">22.97</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">%</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> and </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">32.90</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">%</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> of the Fund&#8217;s net asset value at June 30, 2026 and March 31, 2026, respectively.</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Fund commenced principal operations on July 1, 2025, when the Fund first sold Class I Units and Class S Units (the &#8220;Initial Closing&#8221;) and began investing.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><span></span>
</td>
</tr>

<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>

<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Organization</a></td>
<td class="text"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Organization</span><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">METI Cayman, L.P. (the &#8220;Aggregator&#8221;) is a Cayman Islands exempted limited partnership formed on March 27, 2025, pursuant to the Exempted Limited Partnership Act (as revised) of the Cayman Islands. The Aggregator operates pursuant to the Second Amended and Restated Limited Partnership Agreement, dated July 18, 2025, as further amended and restated (the &#8220;Aggregator Partnership Agreement&#8221;).</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Macquarie S.C.A., SICAV, with respect to its sub-fund Macquarie Energy Transition Infrastructure Fund (&#8220;METI International&#8221;), and Macquarie Energy Transition Infrastructure Fund, L.P. (the &#8220;Fund&#8221;) are the only limited partners of the Aggregator. As of June 30, 2026, the Fund and METI International own </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">20.9</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">%</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> and </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">79.1</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">%</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">, respectively, of the Aggregator. METI Cayman GP, LLC, is the general partner (the &#8220;General Partner&#8221;) of the Aggregator, with the overall responsibility for oversight of the Aggregator.</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Aggregator was established to make, hold, and dispose of portfolio investments which may include debt, equity and derivative instruments.</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Investment operations commenced on July 18, 2025, when the Aggregator began investing in assets, after the Fund sold its first unregistered limited partnership units to third-party investors and subsequently invested those proceeds into the Aggregator, along with METI International&#8217;s investment into the Aggregator.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><span></span>
</td>
</tr>
